raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to perform the core task of reading and extracting specific text from the webpages it opened. Instead of analyzing the content of the search results (e.g., the Britannica page stating "Leaves are the primary sites of photosynthesis"), it simply reported that the browser was open and listed visible UI elements like "Upgrade to our browser" and search filters. This lack of actual content extraction and synthesis prevented the Planner from receiving the necessary citations to finalize the answer, leading to a loop of redundant searches without progress.
